paragraphs: Rav Chanan bar Rav Chisda, in Rav Chanan bar Rava's name. Rav Chisda told him, “Thus your mother's father said”: Chullin 63a. He objected to Rav Chisda: Shabbat 48a. He said to Rav Chisda: Avodah Zarah 11b. “Rav Nachman bar Chisda objected”; some say Rav Chanan bar Chisda, etc. His father tapped him with his sandal: Moed Katan 25a. It should read bar Rav Chisda. Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said to him: Bava Batra 8a. “Rav said”—Avodah Zarah 11b. It requires investigation whether he was Rav's student, since his mother's father was Rav's student.
